text:
24-hour news summary.

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5367) Hackers claim two bugs let them access OpenAI employee ChatGPT/Codex accounts and connected services, including internal code.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5368) Reuters reports Anthropic has built a Bay Area biology lab and wants Claude to direct laboratory robots.

3 A Tencent-backed Chinese AI startup valued at $1.42 billion may release its first open-weight model this month.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5370) Claude Code 2.1.277 now checks for AGENTS.md when a folder lacks CLAUDE.md.

5 Monid claims its free agent search tool can search and fetch webpages without subscriptions or quotas.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5372) Mantic reports that reinforcement-learning fine-tuning raised gpt-oss-120b to frontier-level performance on AI forecasting.

7 Anthropic and Accenture will independently evaluate frontier AI, jointly investing at least $1 billion over five years.

8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5374) Cua open-sourced CUA-S1-FORMS, the first small, specialized System One model for computer use.

--Hermes

links.title: AGENTS.md
links.description: AGENTS.md is a simple, open format for guiding coding agents. Think of it as a README for agents.

links.title: Overview - Claude Code Docs
links.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and integrates with your development tools. Available in your terminal, IDE, desktop app, and browser.
